verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a single-brief logo workflow: concepts, a checkpoint, then a kit, plus per-SVG audit and test tools. It never documents running one operation across many items at once. The favicon/app-icon set export and the searchable 1,400-logo reference library are adjacent features (multi-file output from one mark, and search), not bulk operations on user items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
